composition.title: Hospital discharge report: Bertil Åkesson, Landspítali, 9 to 20 November 2026

sections.title: Alerts
sections.narrative: Penicillin anaphylaxis. Apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily: bleeding risk. Heart failure (NYHA II) and emphysema. Hip precautions for 6 weeks: no flexion over 90 degrees, no internal rotation, no crossing the legs

items.label: Femoral neck fracture, right (Garden IV), fall in Reykjavík
items.note: Fell on the stairs at his son's home in Reykjavík on 9 November 2026. Operated at Landspítali on 10 November 2026.

sections.title: Hospital course
sections.narrative:
Reason for transfer: Return home to Sweden after surgery for a right femoral neck fracture; care continues at Vårdcentralen Kvarnängen and Sjöbacka kommun
Event abroad: Fell on the stairs at his son's home in Reykjavík on 9 November 2026: displaced right femoral neck fracture (Garden IV, S72.0)
Admitted: 9 November 2026
Procedure: Cemented bipolar hemiarthroplasty of the right hip, posterior approach, under spinal anaesthesia; clindamycin prophylaxis because of the penicillin allergy. Uncomplicated, 10 November 2026
Course: Admitted through the emergency department on 9 November after a fall at his son's home in Reykjavík. Apixaban paused; operated the next day under spinal anaesthesia, without complications. Mobilised with the physiotherapist from the first day after surgery, full weight bearing. Haemoglobin fell from 128 to 102 g/L. Blood glucose up to 14 mmol/L, managed with his own insulin glargine. Apixaban restarted on 12 November. Wound dry and healing. Fit to travel home on 20 November

items.label: Cemented bipolar hemiarthroplasty of the right hip
items.note: Posterior approach under spinal anaesthesia. Clindamycin prophylaxis because of penicillin allergy. Uncomplicated, blood loss about 300 ml.

items.label: Blood pressure
items.detail: Systolic blood pressure 132 mmHg, Diastolic blood pressure 74 mmHg; 2026-11-18T08:00:00+00:00

sections.title: Functional status
sections.narrative: Walks about 50 m indoors with his own rollator, full weight bearing. Stairs only with support and a handrail. Needs help with lower-body dressing and compression stockings. Independent eating and hygiene above table height

items.label: Paracetamol 1 g tablet
items.detail: 1 g three times daily for 14 days after surgery

sections.title: Plan of care
sections.narrative:
Planned discharge: 20 November 2026
Travel home: Adapted vehicle or taxi with escort, fit-to-travel certificate issued
Care needs after discharge: Home care; Rehabilitation and physiotherapy; Assistive devices; Wound care; Help with medication; Blood glucose monitoring; Anticoagulation follow-up
Responsible doctor: Yfirlæknir Guðrún Jónsdóttir, Orthopaedic Surgery, Landspítali; 24/7 +354 543 1000, orthopaedic doctor on call
Remarks: Skin staples out on 24 November. Rehabilitation plan (endurhæfingaráætlun) attached for Sjöbacka kommun; operation note and lab and X-ray report attached

attention.title: Medication list not reconciled
attention.detail: The one entry is a statement of what is taken. The document carries no last-dose, dispensing or reconciliation date - confirm with the patient what is actually taken and when the last dose was.
